item.description: The last time our music charts were dominated by vinyl, David Lange was prime minister. Now a new chart tells the story of the shocking renaissance of vinyl in Aotearoa. Summer read – originally published October 15 2025. Calculating the charts used to be the answer to a very simple question: what music sold last week? We had singles, we had albums – but that was it. item.description: A first person account of training AI for tech giants. Summer read – originally published October 23 2025.
